native_baseline.target_task: Which deployed change accounts for the new checkout latency regression, and what bounded causal evidence distinguishes it from load variation?
native_baseline.reference_practitioner: Production reliability engineer specializing in web-service incident diagnosis.
ordinary_methods: Compare deployment and latency timelines, stratifying traffic and configuration.
Replay representative workloads, bisect revisions and test competing causes in staging.
Use rollback and controlled reintroduction when safe; inspect traces and resource metrics.
ordinary_evidence: Version and configuration history; request traces; latency distributions; resource counters.
uncertainty: Scoped authored hypothesis, not verified practitioner consensus.
Teams differ in experimental maturity; this scope includes ordinary staging experiments but no formal inverse-problem specialty.
ordinary_inference_patterns: Temporal association suggests candidates, not unique causation; controlled replay and rollback/reintroduction support bounded causal contribution.
Compare competing causes using traces, load/configuration stratification and disconfirming tests; uncertainty remains when causes are confounded.
ordinary_next_actions: Inspect discriminating traces, test an alternative cause, bisect revisions or safely revert/reintroduce a suspected change.

instrument.state: A reproducible failure occurs for a configuration or input composed of multiple removable parts, and candidate reductions can be repeatedly tested.
instrument.operation: Partition the failure-inducing configuration, remove subsets or test their complements, and iteratively retain reductions that continue to reproduce the defined failure.
instrument.signal: Some reduced configurations preserve the failure while others do not, revealing which removals are compatible with continued reproduction.
instrument.inference: The procedure narrows the configuration to a test-relative minimal or near-minimal failure-inducing subset or difference whose retained parts are sufficient to reproduce the observed failure under the test.
instrument.limit: Interactions among parts, nondeterministic failures, unresolved test outcomes, environmental dependence, and the reduction strategy can prevent strong minimization. A retained minimal configuration demonstrates reproducibility under the test, not necessarily the unique underlying causal mechanism.
